newsitem.title: USA: Curative Health plans 30-35 new centers.
newsitem.headline: Curative Health plans 30-35 new centers.

text.p: Curative Health Services Inc plans to add 30 to 35 new wound centers this year to its existing network of 113, President and Chief Executive Officer John Vakoutis said on Monday.

Vakoutis, speaking at the Hambrecht and Quist Health Care Conference in San Francisco, said the company would also seek to build up its business by establishing a full "continuum of care" system, including free-standing clinics and a home-care network.
Chief Financial Officer John Prior said the company set a target of 10 to 12 percent growth in same-store sales.
